defects.title: After logout, protected routes are not redirected back to /login.
defects.description: Logout correctly clears accessToken, refreshToken, Authuser and deviceIdentity_primary and lands on /login. But navigating back to /home afterwards stays on /home and renders a dead, shell-less page (the Quick Access button never appears) instead of redirecting to the login screen.
defects.expected: Visiting a protected route while signed out redirects to /login.
defects.actual: Observed by 4 test(s) in this failed run: after logout, protected routes redirect back to login [chromium] (failed); after logout, protected routes redirect back to login [firefox] (failed); after logout, protected routes redirect back to login [webkit] (failed); after logout, protected routes redirect back to login [mobile-chrome] (failed)

defects.title: POST /v2/sentMail/postMail/ intermittently returns 401 for a valid session.
defects.description: The same self-send, from a freshly logged-in session with an unexpired token (24h JWT lifetime), is sometimes answered 400 "Duplicate IDs are present in ToAddress, CopyList, or ConfidentialCopyList" (the expected validation) and sometimes 401 — observed switching between the two across consecutive runs on 2026-08-12. A backend that authenticates a session for one request and rejects it for the next is failing auth intermittently; the historical KMail 401 force-logout (now fixed) was the same category of fault.
defects.expected: A valid session is authenticated consistently; postMail never 401s it.
defects.actual: Observed by 4 test(s) in this failed run: sending a mail to yourself is rejected with the documented error [chromium] (failed); sending a mail to yourself is rejected with the documented error [firefox] (failed); sending a mail to yourself is rejected with the documented error [webkit] (failed); sending a mail to yourself is rejected with the documented error [mobile-chrome] (failed)

defects.title: Katchup does not handle a failing contacts backend; it raises instead of degrading.
defects.description: GET localhost:8989/v2/contacts/getImportedPhoneContacts/ and POST localhost:8989/v2/contacts/myUnknownKatchupContacts/ intermittently return 500. The app then raises an unhandled "[object Object]" at handleError rather than degrading, and the conversation/search surface never renders. This is why these tests pass in isolation but fail when the backend happens to error.
defects.expected: A failing contacts call degrades gracefully — the pane still renders and search still reports its result state.
defects.actual: Observed by 8 test(s) in this failed run: searching a unique term updates the feed and clears again [chromium] (failed); the Recents and Contacts tabs both render the conversation feed [chromium] (failed); the Recents and Contacts tabs both render the conversation feed [firefox] (failed); searching a unique term updates the feed and clears again [firefox] (failed); the Recents and Contacts tabs both render the conversation feed [webkit] (failed); searching a unique term updates the feed and clears again [webkit] (failed); searching a unique term updates the feed and clears again [mobile-chrome] (failed); the Recents and Contacts tabs both render the conversation feed [mobile-chrome] (failed)

defects.title: The KEcommerce catalog intermittently renders as an empty pane.
defects.description: During a full serial suite run on 2026-08-12, /e-commerce rendered only the app-shell header with zero merchant tiles (the page snapshot shows an empty content area), failing both catalog tests; the same tests pass 5/5 when the spec runs in isolation, before and after. The module shows no error state when this happens — the catalog is simply missing. Root cause not yet captured (no failed catalog request has been observed; the tile source may be a data call that fails silently or an app-side race under longer sessions).
defects.expected: The catalog renders its merchant tiles on every load, or shows an error state.
defects.actual: Observed by 8 test(s) in this failed run: each sampled merchant tile is visible [chromium] (failed); the merchant catalog renders [chromium] (failed); the merchant catalog renders [firefox] (failed); each sampled merchant tile is visible [firefox] (failed); the merchant catalog renders [webkit] (failed); each sampled merchant tile is visible [webkit] (failed); the merchant catalog renders [mobile-chrome] (failed); each sampled merchant tile is visible [mobile-chrome] (failed)

defects.title: KMail raises an uncaught TypeError on load (UnopenedMailAsync).
defects.description: Uncaught "TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'status')" at UnopenedMailAsync, thrown as soon as /kmail loads. Verified 2026-08-12: the module underneath still functions — all three tabs work once the dev-only overlay is dismissed — so the suite dismisses the overlay (recording it as a "dismissed-app-error" annotation) and verifies the real behaviour. The error itself remains unfixed: in a production build it would surface as the unopened-mail feature failing silently.
defects.expected: KMail loads without raising any uncaught error.
defects.actual: Observed by 4 test(s) in this failed run: the mailbox exposes Recents, Contacts and Status of Mails tabs [chromium] (passed); the mailbox exposes Recents, Contacts and Status of Mails tabs [firefox] (failed); the mailbox exposes Recents, Contacts and Status of Mails tabs [webkit] (failed); the mailbox exposes Recents, Contacts and Status of Mails tabs [mobile-chrome] (failed)

defects.title: KNews renders an empty feed with no error state when its news bridges fail.
defects.description: KNews fetches content through public RSS bridges (corsproxy.io, rss2json.com) that intermittently answer 503/422/429 — rss2json rate-limiting (429) was captured directly. When that happens the main feed renders zero cards and no error or empty-state message (page snapshot: a main landmark with no links), minutes after the same feed rendered normally. A news feed with nothing in it and no explanation is indistinguishable from a broken app to the user.
defects.expected: When the news sources fail, the feed shows an error/retry state instead of silently rendering nothing.
defects.actual: Observed by 8 test(s) in this failed run: the news feed renders cards [chromium] (passed); news cards support click-through (real links with targets) [chromium] (failed); the news feed renders cards [firefox] (failed); news cards support click-through (real links with targets) [firefox] (failed); the news feed renders cards [webkit] (failed); news cards support click-through (real links with targets) [webkit] (failed); the news feed renders cards [mobile-chrome] (failed); news cards support click-through (real links with targets) [mobile-chrome] (failed)

defects.title: The icon rail shows a KPay entry that silently does nothing.
defects.description: The rail renders div.icon-KP_12-KWallet and its expanded labels include "KPay", but clicking either leaves the URL unchanged, Quick Access does not offer the module, and /kpay, /kwallet, and /pay all render the 404 page (verified 2026-08-13). A visible nav entry that silently does nothing is broken UX from the user’s side, whatever the roadmap says — it should be hidden, disabled with an affordance, or wired up.
defects.expected: Rail entries either navigate somewhere or are visibly disabled/absent.
